answer: Trace where each agent's first credits flow in. A key must be funded once before it can earn, and every key whose first deposit traces back, up to 3 hops, to the same inlet wallet shares one reward slot, split evenly. A farm seeding 200 keys from one wallet earns what a single honest agent earns. To look independent it needs 200 funding wallets, each 30+ epochs old with real outside payments, a garden it must tend for a month before the first whisper of profit.
